## LTX-2 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Report LTX-2 Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

# Using LoRAs
**Ctrl + B to enable**

For the camera LoRA we recommend setting strength = 1

You can use LTX [Ready to use camera LoRAs](https://huggingface.co/collections/Lightricks/ltx-2)




Use a second LoRa only when the details are important in the LoRa. 

## Training
We have made available a full trainer to help you to train your own LoRA. You can [find it here](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2).

widgets_values:
Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters. 

By default, we are using 720p resolution. You can try 1920*1088 if you have a powerful GPU.

widgets_values: Duration 7s, cinematic photorealistic: in a warm candlelit kitchen at night, a silver-haired woman with twin braids finishes the last bite of pepperoni pizza at a wooden table, wipes her fingers, exhales, and stands; the camera starts in a steady medium close-up then performs a slow dolly-right with a slight push-in to track her toward the door, racking focus from the brass key in her hand to her eyes as she unlocks it; Destination Rule: the move ends on a tight side profile and the final frame is a frozen hold on the door just opened—cool blue hallway light spilling into the warm room, candle flame bending from the draft, her hand still on the handle; she whispers "吃完了。该走了。"; Audio layers: quiet room tone and fridge hum, candle crackle and wax drip, chew/swallow and napkin cloth, chair scrape and soft footsteps, key jingle/lock click/hinge creak, a cool draft whoosh, minimal low music bed.
